text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I am Dream Journey. It is a pleasure to 
work with you.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
To see the gold that lies at the end of my 
journey... your assistance is 
indispensable.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many storms may buffet us, 
as long as I am with you, we can weather 
them all... Yes, that is what I believe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
